discovery.title: Webb spotted a starry ring galaxy from the universe’s early days
discovery.summary: Astronomers identified GS18660, a ring-shaped galaxy observed as it was billions of years younger than the universe is today. Researchers say a head-on collision may have created its unusual shape.
discovery.why_it_matters: A rare shape in the distant past offers clues to how galaxies collide, form stars, and change over cosmic time.
